given_when_then.given: An Order Request has successfully locked stock for a perishable item
given_when_then.when: The customer cancels the Order Request before the fulfillment task begins
given_when_then.then: The system shall release the locked stock quantity back to the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot for other orders

given_when_then.given: An Order Request has successfully locked stock
given_when_then.when: The Order Request times out within the defined window
given_when_then.then: The system shall automatically release the locked stock quantity back to the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot

given_when_then.given: The system detects a sync failure or latency exceeding the defined threshold
given_when_then.when: The system attempts to allocate or manage locked stock
given_when_then.then: The system shall flag a synchronization discrepancy

success_criteria: Stock quantities must be released back to the Real-Time Inventory Snapshot when an Order Request is cancelled.
Locked stock quantities must be released automatically when an Order Request times out within the defined window.
A synchronization discrepancy must be flagged if data link latency exceeds the defined threshold or if a sync failure is detected.
The system shall allow allocation only if stock is sufficient and not locked by an active or pending order.
